# `mapSomeCatchNoSuchElement`

Suggests Effect.catchNoSuchElement instead of wrapping successes in Option.some and catching NoSuchElementError into Option.none

| Property | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Category | Style |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fixable | Yes |
| Effect versions | v4 |
| Diagnostic codes | `TS377167` |
| Language Service name | `mapSomeCatchNoSuchElement` |
| Oxlint name | `effecttsgo/map-some-catch-no-such-element` |

## Preview

```ts
import { Effect, Option } from "effect"

const users = new Map<string, { readonly name: string }>()

const findUser = (id: string) => Effect.fromNullishOr(users.get(id))

export const lookupUser = (id: string) =>
  findUser(id).pipe(
    Effect.map(Option.some),
    Effect.catchTag("NoSuchElementError", () => Effect.succeed(Option.none()))
/**
    ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ effecttsgo(map-some-catch-no-such-element): Use Effect.catchNoSuchElement instead of wrapping successes in Option.some and catching NoSuchElementError into Option.none.
*/
  )
```
